mbm-1601.clue: I can start a tune without waking the baby.
mbm-1601.quote: My uncle showed me how to tap the clave on a folded napkin. By the time the baby opened her eyes, the whole family was playing son in the kitchen. She took the loudest part.

mbm-1602.clue: I had to borrow the curtains back for one afternoon.
mbm-1602.quote: The checked curtains from our first place became a picnic quilt. When we spread it on the grass, Dad looked up and asked who'd left the window open.

mbm-1603.clue: We've got a trail guide who never walks.
mbm-1603.quote: On each hike I let my little brother move a toy astronaut along the contour lines on the map. At the summit we gave him a real view and photographed his first landing.

mbm-1604.clue: I keep a cork in my pocket for the bass line.
mbm-1604.quote: The choir lost power halfway through rehearsal. I hummed our starting note into an empty bottle. For one afternoon the bass section was me, four friends and a green bottle on the piano.

mbm-1605.clue: My program finishes with a tiny bow.
mbm-1605.quote: When my little sister ties both shoes, she presses a key and the pixel crab on my screen bows. She learned the knots in a week. Then she taught all her stuffed animals to take turns.

mbm-1606.clue: I put bells in the puppet's hat.
mbm-1606.quote: My queen puppet has a tiny bell inside her headdress. The children used to hear her coming before I lifted the curtain. Now I ring it twice on the other side and they howl at the trick.

mbm-1607.clue: My teapot likes a blue cardigan.
mbm-1607.quote: I crocheted a cozy with two little sleeves because the handle looked like an elbow. My grandfather props the spout over the sugar when he pours so the teapot can wave.

mbm-1608.clue: I'd know our street by its paint chips.
mbm-1608.quote: I painted the view from our front step using leftover house paint the neighbors brought over in jam jars. The yellow on the corner house really is the yellow from their porch.

mbm-1609.clue: I keep a spare place at the dry-box picnic.
mbm-1609.quote: We found a bright plastic dinosaur wedged in a willow beside the river. He rode on the rafting guide's helmet all afternoon and posed for the wettest family photo we've ever taken.

mbm-1610.clue: I read one sentence twice every night.
mbm-1610.quote: My uncle used to pencil a star beside the best line in a book. I found one in an old paperback, read the sentence out loud, and heard exactly where he would have slowed down.

mbm-1611.clue: The route changes when the little shadow moves.
mbm-1611.quote: Our favorite climbing hold looks like an elephant only when the morning sun hits it. I made the final reach just in time to catch its trunk before it turned back into a rock.

mbm-1612.clue: I saved the last decal for the toolbox.
mbm-1612.quote: My robot mechanic has a toolbox that opens, with a screwdriver smaller than a grain of rice. The model club voted it best accessory. It took tweezers to get the trophy sticker on.

mbm-1613.clue: I pack orange slices for the top.
mbm-1613.quote: At our climbing gym I used to stop under the painted sun. Last week I tagged its middle, came down and split an orange with my belayer. I'd promised her a piece of sunshine.

mbm-1614.clue: My pencil has a bite out of it.
mbm-1614.quote: At mini golf my ball rolled straight into the painted shark's mouth and stayed there. The attendant gave me a pencil with tooth marks. He said the shark liked to sign autographs.

mbm-1615.clue: My first medal fits in a matchbox.
mbm-1615.quote: We carved a tiny wooden weight plate when my brother finished his first set with me. He gave it back on the day I came back to the gym. We keep passing it over the bench.

mbm-1616.clue: I put my first canoe in a shadow box.
mbm-1616.quote: I couldn't afford the full-size boat, so I carved it from a bar of soap and floated it in the sink. When I finally bought a real canoe, I painted it the same improbable pink.

mbm-1617.clue: My pockets have a secret exit.
mbm-1617.quote: I sewed a narrow ribbon from my mum's key pocket to a button at the waist. She can fish out her keys without putting the grocery bags down. The ribbon used to tie my school braids.

mbm-1618.clue: The left lane is my lucky one for a ridiculous reason.
mbm-1618.quote: At our bowling alley a ceiling tile above lane three has a stain shaped like a duck. I look up after every spare. My teammates have started quacking for me.

mbm-1619.clue: I keep a little weather vane in the kitchen.
mbm-1619.quote: My grandfather built a toy windsock out of his old tie. Before we drive to the airfield I hang it on the washing line. Today the little red tail pointed straight at the breakfast rolls.

mbm-1620.clue: Nobody can agree whose turn the kettle gets.
mbm-1620.quote: We played through a blackout by setting our wooden game pieces on saucers around a lantern. Mum mistook the castle for a sugar lump. We let her keep the extra turn.

mbm-1621.clue: I rent my blanket out by the episode.
mbm-1621.quote: Dad always fell asleep before the detective explained the case. Now I tuck little folded drawings of the suspects into his pajama pocket so he can ask me about it at breakfast.

mbm-1622.clue: I like the hole with the broken lighthouse.
mbm-1622.quote: The mini golf lighthouse has a door that sticks on humid days. I putted while it was open and my little cousin made the foghorn noise. The ball went in on the second honk.

mbm-1623.clue: There's a whole Sunday breakfast on my quilt.
mbm-1623.quote: I kept the little paper shapes under my fabric pieces in a biscuit tin. My niece laid them out as eggs, toast and jam. I liked her breakfast so much I quilted her arrangement instead of mine.

mbm-1624.clue: I played a seaside match against the wind.
mbm-1624.quote: I threw it past our picnic blanket and a gust sent it back at me. My friend wrote two scores in the sand, one for me and one for the sea breeze. The breeze won.

mbm-1625.clue: I kept the very first crack in the paint.
mbm-1625.quote: The finish split on my model's shoulder. I painted a tiny repair ladder leading up to it. Everyone at the club wanted to know how I'd made the damage look quite so convincing.
